guides_list_category_members_wid: Possible members for the currently selected category.
guides_list_category_numbers_wid: List of all objects currently present in the scene for the selected category
guides_list_sides_wid:
Sided category creation. Currently implements Left and Right.
More labels are supported, namely:
F(Front),
B(Back),
U(Up),
D(Down),
These need to be added manually using the 'Search and Replace' tool
 in any combination, making sure to ALWAY have either L or R as the FIRST one in the tags list.
i.e.: L_U_F_Shoulder (Left Up Front Shoulder) is valid for a setup with multiple arms.
guides_list_left_radio: Mark the category being created with the Left tag.
guides_list_right_radio: Mark the category being created with the Right tag.
guides_list_guides_spacing_spin: Spacing between locators in the category chain, in centimeters.
guides_list_components_btn: Stores the selected components' geometric center.
guides_list_guide_btn:
Stores the selected guides to snap them to the geometric 
center of the components stored using the 'Store Components' button.
guides_list_do_it_btn: Snaps the stored guides to the components geometric center.
guides_list_reset_btn: Resets the tool, clearing the data lists (components and guides).
primary_x_radio: Indicates that the X axis has to point towards the next guide in the hierarchy.
primary_y_radio: Indicates that the Y axis has to point towards the next guide in the hierarchy.
primary_z_radio: Indicates that the Z axis has to point towards the next guide in the hierarchy.
secondary_x_radio:
Indicates that the X axis is the most important axis in the rotation order, 
this should NEVER match the twist (primary) axis.
secondary_y_radio:
Indicates that the Y axis is the most important axis in the rotation order, 
this should NEVER match the twist (primary) axis.
secondary_z_radio:
Indicates that the Z axis is the most important axis in the rotation order, 
this should NEVER match the twist (primary) axis.
world_x_radio: Indicates that the Main axis must point to X axis WORLD direction.
world_y_radio: Indicates that the Main axis must point to Y axis WORLD direction.
world_z_radio: Indicates that the Main axis must point to Z axis WORLD direction.
world_direction: Selects which specific direction to point to (positive or negative).
mirror_direction: Indicates along which direction (along which axis) to perform mirroring.
snap_selected:
Snaps selected appendage (i.e: hand or foot) to the corresponding guide in another category (Wrist to Wrist, Ankle to Ankle, etc.)
You can also create custom guides that follow the same pattern and use this tool with them.
attach_selected: Attaches the snapped and selected appendage to the corresponding category by including the appendage's children to the end of the limb's hierarchy.
save_templ_btn:
Save the selected guides setup to file for re-use.
You need to select one category's root to export the whole hierarchy underneath it,
including other cotegories roots.
load_templ_btn: Loads a template from file and creates it in the scene.
root_orient:
Indicates which orientation the root joint should have, either upon creation or after creation, in case you change mind.
Note: reorientation of the root is not possible after a mesh has been bound to the skeleton.
create_root: Creates a root joint, or reorients it if one had already been created.
config_combo: Which configuration to load for the skeleton creation's naming convention.
build_skeleton_btn: Build the Skeleton from the selected root guide.
number_spinbox: How many twist joints to create under the selected joint.
fraction_spinbox: Fraction of the length between the selected joint and the next child in hierarchy for the twist joints to be created.
update_guides_btn: Enable updating guides position and rotations by manipulating the built skeleton's joints.
update_joints_btn: Enable updating joints positions and rotations by manipulating the built guides' hierarchy.
influences_number_slider:
Maximum number of joints each vertex will be influenced by.
This will be enforced by the interactive normalization.
bind_to_combo:
What to bind the selected meshes to.
'Joints Hierarchy' will bind the geometry to the whole skeleton.
'Selected Joints' will bind the geometry to only the exact set of joints currently selected.
bind_method_combo: Method used to assign weights to the bound geometry's vertices.
skin_method_combo:
Skin method to apply to the skin cluster.
Some game engines support dual quaternion, which helps with maintaining volumes
around bending areas and avoiding pinched meshes when twisting.
hik_btn:
Performs the skeleton's HumanIK characterization process.
NOTE: Make sure to have the matching configuration 
selected under the 'Skeleton Joints Tools' 
and a bind pose created beforehand.
posing_tool_refresh_btn:
Populates the table below with the necessary elements to create a T-Pose for the selected joints.
Requires a selection of joints (usually arms and legs) to define which
world direction they should be pointing at to have a perfect T-Pose.
posing_tool_make_t_pose_btn: Generates a new T-Pose from the data in the table above.
posing_tool_save_t_pose_btn: Saves (or updates) the character's new T-Pose.
posing_tool_save_bind_pose_btn: Saves (or updates) the character's new bind pose.
guides_list_do_it_rot_btn:
Snaps the stored guides to the position of the stored components and rotates them to the component normal.
The selections order matters: first guide will snap and rotate to the first component, and so on.
The method will clip to the shortest of the two lists if their length do not match.
Recommended for face joints placement.
guides_load_preset_btn: Load selected preset from current selector name.
guides_save_preset_btn: Save selected preset from current selector name.
pose_list_refresh_btn: Refreshes the list of all available bind poses.
pose_list_go_to_bindpose_btn: Goes to the selected bind pose in the list.
